name: recover a target-model dag from observational data with ambiguity resolution
definition: apply structure learning over observed column samples following given heuristics (root constraint, fixed edge count, analogical child rule for ambiguous directions) to infer a unique edge set.
failure_mode: an ambiguity misresolved or missing edge breaks the set equality

name: recover an unlinked file open file-descriptor content
definition: Read the contents of a file that was removed from its namespath but is still referenced by an open descriptor, typically via proc memmap or by copying the fd.
failure_mode: Failure to recover / wrong fd read.

name: recover deleted/embedded files and materialize them byte-accurately into a clean directory
definition: Recover erased files from the filesystem via forensics/carving and write the exact payloads/candidates into a dedicated clean target directory with nothing extra.
failure_mode: the file was not physically recoverable from the store within the container, so the expected token is absent from the guesses

name: reverse a single-key byte transform to recover the valid WAL
definition: Apply the inverse byte operation (here, an XOR with a single-byte key, per-column to every byte) so the result is a valid WAL header/magic that sqlite accepts.
failure_mode: Wrong leading bytes cause the decrypted file to be read as non-WAL; recovery fails.
